abstract: We document that traditional energy firms are key innovators in the United States’ green patent landscape. These firms produce more, and significantly higher-quality, green innovation. In many green technology spaces, they appear to be influential first movers and to produce ongoing foundational aspects of innovation and commercialization on which other alternative energy producers build. They additionally invest significantly in labor and capital to complement these green innovations. These traditional energy firms, however, receive significantly lower environmental, social, and governance (ESG) scores and fund flows and are not rewarded for incremental green innovation. This behavior is consistent with a competitive response by traditional energy firms to preempt obsolescence of current technology by investing in future replacement technologies. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: Funding was provided by the National Science Foundation [Grant SciSIP 1535813] and the Fordham University Gabelli School of Business—PVH Corp. Global Thought Leadership Grant on Corporate Social Responsibility. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.09124 .
abstract_zh: 我们记录了传统能源公司是美国绿色专利领域的关键创新者。这些公司产生了更多且质量显著更高的绿色创新。在许多绿色技术领域，它们似乎是具有影响力的先行者，并持续产出其他替代能源生产商所依赖的创新与商业化的基础性成果。它们还投入大量劳动力和资本，以补充这些绿色创新。然而，这些传统能源公司获得的环境、社会和治理（ESG）评分以及资金流入显著较低，并且其渐进式绿色创新并未得到回报。这种行为与传统能源公司通过投资未来替代技术来抢先应对当前技术被淘汰的竞争性反应相一致。本文由金融学领域的Bo Becker接收。资助：资助来自美国国家科学基金会[Grant SciSIP 1535813]以及福特汉姆大学加贝利商学院—PVH Corp.企业社会责任全球思想领导力资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.09124获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: The ESG-Innovation Disconnect: Evidence from Green Patenting
title_zh: ESG与创新的脱节：来自绿色专利的证据

abstract: Violent conflict has enduring effects on child health, but the speed at which these effects manifest is not fully understood. By use of data from a decade before to shortly after the Nigerian Boko Haram insurgency extended across the border to Cameroon, this study investigates the immediate effects of a deteriorating security environment caused by foreign-born insurgent terrorism on children’s health. Boko Haram attacks decrease weight-for-height for children under 5 years—an indicator of short-term health and nutrition—within an average of 2.6 months after the attacks. This effect is likely driven by a reduction in health-care service utilization, which can exacerbate the prevalence and the severity of conditions such as fever and diarrhea. However, the attacks do not affect dietary diversity or child mortality. The results underscore the importance of maintaining accessibility to health-care service after the start of terrorist violence to prevent irreversible effects, a concern that is increasingly relevant for countries combating the infiltration of foreign terrorists.
abstract_zh: 暴力冲突对儿童健康具有持久影响，但这些影响显现的速度尚未完全明了。本研究利用尼日利亚博科圣地叛乱跨越边境蔓延至喀麦隆前后十年的数据，探讨了由外国出生的叛乱恐怖主义导致的安全环境恶化对儿童健康的即时影响。博科圣地袭击在平均2.6个月内降低了5岁以下儿童的体重-身高比——这是衡量短期健康和营养状况的指标。这一效应很可能源于医疗服务利用的减少，这可能会加剧发烧和腹泻等疾病的患病率及严重程度。然而，袭击并未影响饮食多样性或儿童死亡率。研究结果强调了在恐怖暴力开始后保持医疗服务可及性的重要性，以防止不可逆的影响，这对于正在应对外国恐怖分子渗透的国家而言日益相关。
title: Unpacking the Links between Conflict and Child Health: Evidence from a Foreign Insurgency
title_zh: 冲突与儿童健康关联解析：来自外国叛乱的证据

abstract: Abstract Ecolabels aim to promote sustainable production practices, but their effectiveness in incentivizing producers remains debated, particularly in settings where there are groups of producers being certified. This reflects similar challenges as in other producer programs, such as generic marketing and quality programs. In the case of fisheries, for instance, the evidence with respect to the existence of price premiums at the producer level is mixed. This is partly due to limited access to upstream data that captures variations in market demand for ecolabeled products. This study uses firm‐level data from the Norwegian cod supply chain, encompassing purchase and sales prices over 8 years for two firms, to assess if a premium is associated with the ecolabel of the Marine Stewardship Council (MSC). Our data highlight that the firms handle both MSC‐certified and uncertified cod, indicating that certification is one of several product attributes. We find that there is a premium associated with the MSC label and that it is passed upstream. In addition, product form, size, and market destination significantly influence value distribution, and regional market variation shows substantial premiums in Northern and Western Europe but none in Eastern Europe.
abstract_zh: 生态标签旨在促进可持续生产实践，但其激励生产者的有效性仍存争议，尤其是在涉及生产者群体认证的情境下。这反映了与其他生产者计划（如通用营销和质量计划）类似的挑战。以渔业为例，关于生产者层面是否存在价格溢价的证据并不一致。部分原因在于获取上游数据的途径有限，这些数据能够捕捉生态标签产品市场需求的变化。本研究利用挪威鳕鱼供应链的企业层面数据，涵盖两家企业8年间的采购和销售价格，以评估海洋管理委员会（MSC）生态标签是否与溢价相关。我们的数据表明，这些企业同时处理MSC认证和未认证的鳕鱼，表明认证仅是众多产品属性之一。我们发现，MSC标签确实与溢价相关，且该溢价向上游传递。此外，产品形态、规格和市场目的地显著影响价值分配，区域市场差异显示北欧和西欧存在显著溢价，而东欧则无溢价。
title: Do ecolabel price premiums move upstream? A firm‐level analysis of the Marine Stewardship Council ecolabel
title_zh: 生态标签价格溢价是否向上游转移？基于海洋管理委员会生态标签的企业层面分析

abstract: This paper is motivated by the observed discrepancy between rising price volatility and declining hedging demand in the European Union Emission Trading System (EU ETS). To investigate whether the effectiveness of carbon futures as hedging instruments persists under varying scenarios, this paper evaluates the evolving price risk in the EU carbon market and examines the role of hedging in managing the risk. It investigates tail risk (corresponding to adverse market shocks occurring under rare events) and its temporal evolution over successive phases of EU carbon policy. Price risk is assessed empirically based on a quantile vector autoregression model of marginal price distributions along with a copula evaluation of the joint distribution of futures price and spot price. Applied to EU Allowance market over the period of 2008–2023, we find that: (1) the price distributions of both spot and futures market exhibit heavy‐tailed and leptokurtosis properties, thereby highlighting the significance of tail risk under changing policy schemes, such as the four phases of the EU ETS and shifting emission and energy policies; (2) decomposing the cost of risk across quantiles, we show that the risk located at the lower tail of the price distributions plays a dominant role; (3) we propose a novel Minimum Cost‐of‐Risk method based on the quantile vector autoregression, which more effectively evaluates the overall hedging performance in terms of cost of risk reduction compared to the traditional Minimum−Variance method.
abstract_zh: 本文源于对欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）中价格波动加剧与对冲需求下降之间观察到的差异的思考。为探究碳期货作为对冲工具的有效性在不同情境下是否持续，本文评估了欧盟碳市场中不断演变的价格风险，并考察了对冲在风险管理中的作用。研究聚焦于尾部风险（对应于罕见事件下不利市场冲击）及其在欧盟碳政策各连续阶段中的时间演变。价格风险基于分位数向量自回归模型对边际价格分布进行实证评估，并结合copula方法评价期货价格与现货价格的联合分布。应用于2008年至2023年间的欧盟配额市场，我们发现：（1）现货和期货市场的价格分布均表现出厚尾和尖峰特征，从而凸显了在政策方案变化（如EU ETS的四个阶段及排放和能源政策的转变）下尾部风险的重要性；（2）通过跨分位数分解风险成本，我们表明位于价格分布下尾部的风险起主导作用；（3）我们提出一种基于分位数向量自回归的新型最小风险成本方法，与传统最小方差方法相比，该方法在风险成本降低方面能更有效地评估整体对冲绩效。
title: Evolution and management of price risk in the carbon market: The role of hedging
title_zh: 碳市场价格风险的演变与管理：对冲的作用
